tutorial_text.text:
THE RAPPER

Deceptively adept at combat (Despite a strange weapon),

Boyfriend wields bravado and confidence with exceptional flow.



NOTE ATTACKS

Pressing attack in time with a singing note makes the attack unblockable,

consuming less stamina, dealing greater damage, and bypassing enemy defenses.



PRESSURE TO PERFORM

Boyfriend will still be defeated if his stamina fully depletes.

A sound will play to warn if your attacks are close to depleting stamina.

Note that "stamina" is the same health used for note misses/hits.



SPECIAL: POSE

Boyfriend can "pose" using "$specialBind" to trade half your health for stamina.

Works well with parrying, to restore health and stamina for more attacks.
